locations.text: 8. Model discipline (register B21; public.model_assignments names the model for every lane and public.runner_model_lanes mirrors it — read it live, never assume): you are the orchestrator lane; its row names your model. The governance agents do the judgment steps through scripts/agent-prompt.js exactly as the runbook's steps 4b, 4c, 6 and 7 say — the Researcher, the Prioritizer, the Designer, the Builder and the Verifier run as sub-agents via the Agent tool on the judgment lane — the model scripts/agent-prompt.js prints for the call (the judgment lane's row unless public.judgment_model() has degraded it to the orchestrator lane because Fable is past its daily share, SES-395); mechanical delegated steps (doc sweeps, imports, formatting) go to the mechanical lane. State the clone's absolute path in every sub-agent prompt. A failed attempt re-runs that piece one tier up — never a second attempt at the same tier. If the Agent tool is unavailable in this environment, note that in the cycle row and continue on the orchestrator lane.
